parsed.name: Triton 200低温制冷系统
parsed.description: 用于超低温实验的Triton 200低温制冷系统，可读取Cernox或RuO2温度通道、设置温度设定值、更新加热器、执行受控升降温，并控制涡轮泵等低温系统部件。
parsed.description_en: The Triton 200 is a cryogenic refrigeration system for ultra-low-temperature experiments. It supports reading Cernox or RuO2 temperature channels, setting temperature setpoints, updating heater behavior, running controlled temperature ramps, and controlling subsystems such as a turbo pump.

actions.description: 停止当前温度通道的受控温度扫描。
actions.description_en: Stop a controlled temperature sweep on the current temperature channel.

actions.description: 启动当前温度通道的受控温度扫描。
actions.description_en: Start a controlled temperature sweep on the current temperature channel.

actions.description: 向Triton 200发送原始查询命令并接收响应。
actions.description_en: Send a raw query command to the Triton 200 and receive the response.
Get/set the temperature channel (Cernox 5 or RuO2 6).

actions.description: 将加热器关联到当前温度通道，并按当前温度设定值更新加热电流。
actions.description_en: Associate the heater with the current temperature channel and update the heater current according to the current temperature setpoint.

actions.description: 获取当前温度通道的温度读数。
actions.description_en: Get the temperature reading from the current temperature channel.

actions.description: 从设备响应中提取指定名词和单位对应的数值。
actions.description_en: Extract the value corresponding to a specified noun and unit from a device response.
